text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I thought I would learn some kind of<n>new magic on
my birthday...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But I still can't call down lightning,<n>summon rain
clouds, or even fly<n>through the sky!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
C'mooon! How long do I have to wait<n>to become a
witch?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what if I pick you up so it feels<n>like you're flying
through the sky?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Don't treat me like a little kid!<n>Besides, that's not
even magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Although... that does sound kinda fun,<n>so I'll let you
carry me just this once!
